spec.description: 120 x 80 x 20 mm hook plate; y is up. Idealize the bolted beam attachment as fully fixed over y=80. Apply the hanging load downward on the lower-right corner edge (x=120,y=0), uniformly across the 20 mm thickness. Steel elastic constants assumed; no passive regions specified.
